entities.summary: Final Scratch is a DJ tool created by the Dutch company N2IT with input from Richie Hawtin and John Acquaviva. It allows manipulation and playback of digital audio sources using traditional vinyl and turntables. It seeks to cross the divide between the versatility of digital audio and the tactile control of vinyl turntablism.
